headline: Executive order sets up a presidential advisory council on helping Americans manage their money.
what_it_does: This order creates the President's Advisory Council on Financial Capability. Based on its title, the council's job is to give the President advice on how to help people build the knowledge and skills to manage their money. No summary was provided, so details such as who serves on the council, how long it lasts, and its exact duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: People chosen to serve on the council
who_it_affects.how: They would be asked to give the President advice on financial capability issues.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 29, 2010; no separate start date was given in the material provided.
